title: APD evaluation corpus
description: A corpus manifest (eval/<area>/corpus.yaml, or eval/local/ for private runs): the labelled entries an evaluator scores, each in the dev or the held-out set. An entry names a finished run directory, a repository pinned by commit, or both, and its labels file (eval-labels.schema.json). `run` and `labels` are relative to the manifest's directory. The loader also refuses duplicate ids and any run or (repo url, commit) that appears in both sets.

set.description: dev: tuning and calibration happen here. heldout: run only after `eval freeze`.

run.description: A finished run directory, relative to the manifest's directory or absolute.

labels.description: The entry's eval-labels file, relative to the manifest's directory or absolute.

licence.description: The licence of the pinned repository (for example Apache-2.0).
